question: Do the same sparse checkpoints that forecast better on Allen--Cahn expose label-free support families that carry out-of-sample finite-time fate information and have support-specific predictive utility?
claim_boundary: A positive result is a same-checkpoint mechanistic bridge, not formal causal mediation and not single-component attribution: the sparse treatment jointly changes soft-thresholding and L1 loss.

conditional_launch.outcome_independent: No bridge threshold or feature definition may change after reading the mechanism decision. Failure terminates the bridge without generating data.

new_datasets.immutability: All three files and summaries must be absent before launch, generated together after the conditional guard, hashed before semantic access, and never overwritten.

roster.rollout: direct repeated global K without periodic reencoding

field_only_stage.new_route: each unseen x0 independently assigned to the train-only codebook before future encoding
field_only_stage.future_access: The monolithic torch payload and future field tensors are deserialized before routing, but only x0 values are encoded or read for route construction; future values may be encoded only after routes and probe features at x0 are sealed.
field_only_stage.label_firewall: torch.load may deserialize label tensors embedded in the monolithic files. The field-only code never requests a label key, indexes a label tensor, or uses a label value; artifacts and manifests record deserialization separately from semantic key/value access.
field_only_stage.outputs: features, route identifiers, support stability, per-trajectory forecast errors, and final predicted/truth fields; no label-valued metadata

support.dense_binary_control: stable-index top-k abs(dense z0), with k matched to paired sparse support cardinality per trajectory
support.wrong_support_control: For every train-fit sparse family, select another family by closest cardinality then training count; resize its train-only coordinate-frequency prototype to the target cardinality, require a distinct mask, and freeze it before routing any new trajectory.

forecast_estimands.ordinary: sparse full versus dense full at H160/H200 primary and H400 secondary
forecast_estimands.correct_route: train-fit sparse family representative selected from unseen x0 only and fixed for the rollout
forecast_estimands.wrong_route: Apply the train-frozen same-cardinality wrong prototype for the x0-selected family. Correct/wrong mask-once and repeated-restriction rollouts use exactly the same eligible trajectories, K, decoder, and projected-state cardinality.
forecast_estimands.routing_evaluable_models: Freeze model-seed eligibility before reading forecast errors or fates: a model is routing-evaluable only when all three untouched datasets have a covered, distinct, same-cardinality wrong-family control. Require at least 8 of 10 model seeds and analyze their complete model-by-dataset cross; report every exclusion.
forecast_estimands.restriction_interaction: At each horizon report (correct restricted / correct mask-once) / (wrong restricted / wrong mask-once); a value below one isolates support-specific repeated restriction beyond the shared t0 projection cost.
initial_projection_controls: correct and wrong latent-energy capture at t0
correct and wrong reconstruction MSE at t0
mask-once and restricted share identical t0 state
forecast_estimands.always_report: Both mean and terminal errors, finite fractions, all dataset seeds, all model seeds, and the original failed four-cell confirmation gate.

label_aware_stage.start_condition: field-only artifacts are complete, immutable, and manifest-hashed before any label key is accessed; prior payload-level label-tensor deserialization is disclosed, not misreported as byte-level isolation
label_aware_stage.new_fate: nearest fixed Allen--Cahn well of the modal grid area at each scored physical horizon
label_aware_stage.use_of_labels: evaluation and post-hoc probe fitting only; labels never train or route a KAE

probes.test_rows: each untouched 256-trajectory dataset, never pooled for model selection
probes.model: standardized linear ridge one-vs-rest classifier in the dual
probes.selection_metric: balanced accuracy; ties select the larger alpha
probes.fairness: Identical folds, alpha grid, standardization, classifier, and target for all feature sets; dense values and raw x0 are steelman controls.

h400_truth_difficulty.modal_fate_change_fraction: fraction whose modal nearest-well fate differs at H200 and H400
h400_truth_difficulty.dynamic_label_rule: Deduplicate the ten model repeats and classify the three unique datasets only. Call H400 dynamic temporal extrapolation only if the ratio of unique-dataset mean continued-change MSE to unique-dataset mean H200 change MSE is at least 0.05 or the unique-dataset mean modal-fate change fraction is at least 0.05; otherwise call it asymptotic-stability extrapolation.
h400_truth_difficulty.claim_policy: H400 is always secondary and can never rescue a failed H160/H200 primary bridge.

aggregation.trajectory_reduction: average trajectories within each model-by-dataset cell
aggregation.point_estimate: equal-weight arithmetic mean over the crossed 10-by-3 cells
aggregation.interval: two-way percentile bootstrap resampling model seeds and dataset seeds independently
aggregation.reporting: always report each dataset seed and each model-seed paired difference, through-horizon MSE, terminal MSE, and modal-fate accuracy; forecast/alignment/probe use all 10 model seeds, while routing uses the frozen complete-case subset of at least 8 model seeds with distinct controls on all three datasets and reports exclusions; never treat 768 trajectories or repeated copies of a dataset's H400 truth difficulty as independent replications

generation_hardware.telemetry_scope: end-to-end pinned generator invocation, including initialization, numerical integration, transfer, and save; each dataset must independently pass and raw telemetry is hash-frozen

hardware.batch_selection: reuse the independently audited smallest-passing batch from the related paired-checkpoint support kernel, then require every bridge extraction task to pass end-to-end telemetry for its larger four-mode H400 kernel
hardware.telemetry_scope: evaluator-owned marker interval around synchronized H160/H200/H400 direct, correct mask-once/restricted, and wrong mask-once/restricted rollout kernels after models, data, features, and train-only routes are resident; excludes preload, I/O, CPU label-free preprocessing, and serialization

decision_branches.same_checkpoint_mechanistic_bridge: Forecast replication, family alignment, support probe, and correct-over-wrong routing all pass. Claim predictively useful out-of-sample support structure with bounded mechanistic evidence.
decision_branches.forecast_and_alignment_without_routing: Forecast and representation transfer, but support identity lacks intervention-specific utility; make correlational representation and forecast claims separately.
decision_branches.forecast_only: New-data forecasting replicates but support alignment/probe evidence fails; do not connect representation to forecasting.
decision_branches.representation_only: Support/fate evidence transfers but sparse forecasting does not replicate; do not claim it explains forecasting.
decision_branches.failed: Neither bridge component passes; preserve all negative results and make no new claim.
decision_branches.invalid: Any source, roster, firewall, seed, finite-value, artifact-integrity, or conditional-launch guard fails.

provenance.reserved_seed_policy: Any path or runtime argument containing 20260725 aborts.
provenance.root_of_trust: Exact source manifest plus hardcoded card/source/mechanism-decision hashes in dormant launchers; dataset and field-only manifests are added as immutable post-generation roots before later stages.
provenance.no_launch_status: This bridge card and code may be audited and tested synthetically, but no generation/evaluation job is authorized until the parent support-subspace experiment qualifies, all static tests pass, the card/source roots are refrozen, and an independent reviewer explicitly authorizes generation.
